variant_title_en: Fractions — Fish Sauce in a Bottle
title_en: Fractions — Fish Sauce in a Bottle
story_theme_en: Mom has 1 bottle of fish sauce. She poured out 3/5 of the bottle for cooking. She used 2/5 of the bottle. How much fish sauce is left as a fraction of the full bottle? If the full bottle holds 500 milliliters, how much is left in milliliters?
helper_tip: When adding or subtracting fractions, make the denominators equal first.
hint_th: บวกลบเศษส่วนต้องทำส่วนให้เท่ากัน

data.content_en: Mom has 1 bottle of fish sauce. She poured out 3/5 of the bottle for cooking. She used 2/5 of the bottle. How much fish sauce is left as a fraction of the full bottle? If the full bottle holds 500 milliliters, how much is left in milliliters?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Fish sauce left = 5/5 - 3/5 - 2/5 = 0/5 = 0 of the bottle. Volume left = 500 x 0/5 = 0 mL. The bottle is empty.

data.content_en: Fish sauce left = 5/5 - 3/5 - 2/5 = 0/5 = 0 of the bottle. Volume left = 500 x 0/5 = 0 mL. The bottle is empty.

visual_blocks.question: There is 1 orange. You give a friend 2/6 of the orange, then give another friend 1/6. How much of the orange is left?
